title: Serve With the Gifts God Has Given
opening: God gives different gifts so that believers can serve one another. Ministry is not only a platform; it is faithful service expressed in everyday life.
points: Recognise the abilities and opportunities God has placed in your hands.
Use your gifts to help others rather than seek praise.
Work together with humility, honouring the contribution of others.
reflection: What practical act of service can you offer this week?
prayer: Lord, show me how to use my gifts faithfully. Help me serve with humility, love, and excellence. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
